units.source_text: “槿姬身为斋院，他竟不顾亵渎神明，偷偷寄送情书，

en.t: Although Princess Asagao was serving as the Kamo priestess, he disregarded the sacrilege against the gods and secretly sent her love letters,

units.source_text: 百般追求，世人已有谣传。

en.t: pursuing her in every possible way, and rumors had already spread among the people.

units.source_text: 此等渎神之事，不但有伤于世道，且亦不利于自身。

en.t: Such an act of sacrilege would not only harm public morality, but would also bring no benefit to himself.

units.source_text: 我推想他总不至于做出犯天下之大不韪的事来吧。

en.t: I imagined that surely he would not go so far as to commit an offense condemned by the whole world.

units.source_text: 况且他是今世有识之人，风靡天下，拔类超群，

en.t: Besides, he is a man of discernment in this age, admired throughout the realm and far surpassing his peers,

units.source_text: 故我一向不曾怀疑他的用心，岂知……”

en.t: so I had never once doubted his intentions, and yet who could have known...
